# Access And Egress Checklist: Access, Sharing, And Downloads

**Purpose**: Validate access, sharing, download, export, and audit requirement quality before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are owner-only, team-visible, individually shared, denied, deleted, and unavailable meeting access states specified? [Completeness, Spec FR-001, Data Model §MeetingAccessState]
- [x] CHK002 Are list and detail access requirements both covered instead of only detail-route authorization? [Coverage, Spec FR-002, SC-001]
- [x] CHK003 Are grant and revoke requirements defined for specific authenticated users and permitted admins/owners? [Completeness, Spec FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 Are team visibility requirements defined separately from public-link behavior? [Clarity, Spec FR-005/FR-014]
- [x] CHK005 Are download/export policy decisions separate for audio, transcript, summary, and combined package? [Completeness, Spec FR-009]
- [x] CHK006 Are direct download/export destinations required to re-check current authorization and artifact lifecycle at access time? [Coverage, Spec FR-011]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK007 Are revoked share, removed membership, inactive account, and artifact-deleted-while-share-active scenarios specified? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK008 Are unauthenticated share-link opens specified to require login before private metadata exposure? [Coverage, Spec US2]
- [x] CHK009 Are duplicate-access cases specified when a recipient already has team-level or owner access? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Are direct artifact URL attempts by unauthorized users specified as denied without exposing storage or artifact path details? [Coverage, Spec US3]
- [x] CHK011 Are partial export packages specified to disclose included and excluded artifact classes with safe reasons? [Clarity, Spec US4, Research §Export Packages]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 Can all access outcomes be validated within one page refresh or retry after grant/revoke? [Measurability, Spec SC-003]
- [x] CHK013 Can artifact policy validation prove audio, transcript, summary, package, missing, deleted, and policy-disabled states? [Measurability, Spec SC-004]
- [x] CHK014 Can audit evidence prove share, revoke, denied access, download, and export without private content or secrets? [Measurability, Spec SC-005]

## Notes

- Access/egress checklist passes. Requirements are specific enough to generate dependency-ordered implementation tasks.
